rationale.intuition: Olin overall admit ~17% (~360 applicants per ~85 enrolled). Olin uses a unique Candidates' Weekend (invitation-only) where finalists do collaborative engineering projects with current students — this is binding-like behavioral selection, not portfolio. Pure stats matter less than collaborative/maker temperament + 'engineering mindset' demonstrated through hands-on builds. Strong STEM profile + maker-space leadership + open-source maintenance is well-aligned. Industry: 15-30% for stats-strong + hands-on-builder profile; lower for pure paper-credential applicants. Engine treats as SPECIALTY (ENGINEERING_NO_PHD) — normal path, but no CDS bands and no signal for 'maker temperament'.

sources.name: Olin College Admissions Profile 2023-24
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 17%; Candidates' Weekend invitation is the de facto admit pool (~3x normal admit rate among invitees); SAT mid-50% 1470-1560

sources.name: Olin College Admissions Blog 2024
sources.evidence: Olin's own admissions team explicitly notes 'we are looking for collaborative builders and tinkerers, not test scores' — maker-portfolio (independent projects, hands-on engineering, open-source) is weighted heavily

sources.name: Counselor Engine SPECIALTY type
sources.evidence: Olin → ENGINEERING_NO_PHD → SPECIALTY institutionType per ranking-catalog. Does NOT trigger audition short-circuit; normal CDS path applies but no bands seeded. Engine likely falls back to overallAcceptanceRate × profile multipliers.
